scope: Selected opening protected, shared, quiet, unclassified, crossing and retained works, offline exports, print and scripts off. Empty real choices prove truthful scope, not useful works.  Nonempty fixture choices are unit-tested. Goal/stage packages, other shared views and full browser acceptance remain open. This is not performance proof.
